run_kuka_cam_grasping_training: run the KUKA camera grasping reinforcement learning training script with Deep Q-Network
create_deepq_model: create a CNN to MLP model using deepq.models.cnn_to_mlp with convolutional and hidden layers
train_deepq_agent: train a Deep Q-Network agent using deepq.learn with custom hyperparameters and callback
review_callback_function: review the callback function that stops training when episode rewards exceed a threshold
save_trained_model: save the trained Deep Q-Network agent model to a pickle file using act.save
